title: ToolSurface Canonical Tool Description
description: A conformant MCP tool description: a JSON object of at most five fields, no free prose outside them. Governs the content of the MCP `description` field only.

purpose.description: One factual sentence. Must not name or instruct another tool.

params.description: Plain-language summary that references the inputSchema; never restates it.

examples.description: Bounded list of real input/output pairs. No instructions inside them.
